mods.name: The Metallic Arts
mods.description: Release candidate: metal economy, all sixteen standard Allomantic and Feruchemical metals, typed Hemalurgy, canonical invested equipment, and documented bounded game adaptations. Includes compounding, prepared player constructs, survival discovery, mixed vials and typed-core carriers; unknown god metals and external acceptance remain documented work.

releases.notes:
# The Metallic Arts 1.0.0-rc.3

Minecraft **26.1**, Java **25**, Fabric Loader **0.18.4+**, Fabric API **0.145.1+26.1**. Stop the game/server, back up the whole world/configs, remove the old mod jar and install the ordinary jar on both sides. Sources are for development.

- Stable camera-local blue sight: in-view rays, distance-sized diamonds, distance labels and explicit rear/off-screen markers. No mirrored rear rays into the sky.
- Metal grouping is six face neighbors only; diagonal contacts do not join a source. N / Auto metals toggles automatic discovered-source selection. H clears and disables it. Shared force budgets and scan limits remain.
- Real particle sphere shells replace drawn wireframes. Bendalloy radius is four blocks; Cadmium is eight, subject to the host cap. All supported players/local clocks retain entry/exit behavior; caster movement no longer receives duplicate time multipliers.
- `/metallicarts grantall PLAYER` grants every standard Allomantic/Feruchemical power idempotently. `/metallicarts fuelall PLAYER MICROGRAMS` adds that amount to each Allomantic fuel reserve. Both require operator permission; fuel does not fill metalminds.
- Duralumin amplification lasts 100 ticks. Other active eligible fuel pays once; Duralumin burns normally during that window and switches off automatically. Late burns use the remaining window. Supported NPC burners share the finite rule.
- Independent Zinc/Brass emotion selectors influence protected nearby eligible minds. Soothing anger calms attacks until provoked; soothing trust creates distrust/hostility, including a temporary finite melee response in ordinary passive mobs. Copper, range/line of sight, resistance and permission checks remain. Boss exceptions are explicit.
- All sixteen metals appear together in M: wide radial constellation or complete narrow grid, plus an owned-metal world HUD. I / inventory Arts help explains current bindings and behavior.

Read [exact behavior and limits](https://github.com/RashekKholin/metallic-arts-fabric/blob/main/docs/RC3_REFINEMENTS.md), [current verification](https://github.com/RashekKholin/metallic-arts-fabric/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_VALIDATION.md) and the [README](https://github.com/RashekKholin/metallic-arts-fabric#readme). RC2 evidence is archived separately. This is an immutable release candidate under All rights reserved; remote authenticated acceptance, hours-long survival/capacity balance, complete Spanish/accessibility/hardware review and distribution permissions remain separate gates. No Modrinth submission has been made.

releases.notes:
# The Metallic Arts 1.0.0-rc.2

Minecraft Java **26.1**, Java **25**, Fabric Loader **0.18.4+**, Fabric API **0.145.1+26.1**. Install the ordinary jar on server and clients; the sources jar is for development. Stop the game, back up the whole world/configs and remove the old mod jar before upgrading.

- Requested gameplay fixes: automatic/recovered coin locks, ten-second range retention, connected sources, distance falloff, all-direction blue sight, aluminum/alloy immunity, full-sphere player effects, 64-item stacks, live controls help and faster visible Bendalloy nutrition. See REQUESTED_GAMEPLAY.md for exact limits.
- All rights reserved license selected by the owner, included in ordinary/source jars with explicit gameplay/server-use permission.
- Real NPC storage/tapping with canonical equipment, finite fuel/charge and actual attribute costs; expanded paid standard-metal AI.
- Distinct Koloss/Inquisitor/Kandra NPCs, prepared implants, dependencies, original skins and material-fed forms.
- Rare research camps, finite supplies, researcher profiles, advancement onboarding, a craftable field guide and persistent faction standing.
- Separate finite pure Atium/Nalatium/Malatium interpretations; protected Harmonium/Trellium material transactions and terrain-safe water reactions. Unknown shard-metal abilities remain unresolved.
- Explicit opt-in memory movement and past-vision consent; no raw private journal broadcast.
- Optional real OpenPAC integration, protected loose-force anchors/recoil/time, canonical lease recovery, older-version migration and intentional partial-save crash fixtures.
- Eleven guide pages, 32 metal lessons, rebindable contextual keys, client sensory settings, original item art and narrow-menu/native-rendering checks. Spanish remains partial.
- Expanded CI gates for native server operating systems, Linux software-rendered clients, pinned claim compatibility and save recovery before publishing this immutable prerelease.

The public host-disableable RashekKholin/The17thShard verified-UUID access remains. It grants standard Arts access, no operator privileges or free resources.

Read the [README](https://github.com/RashekKholin/metallic-arts-fabric#readme), [verified results](https://github.com/RashekKholin/metallic-arts-fabric/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_VALIDATION.md) and [acceptance/future work](https://github.com/RashekKholin/metallic-arts-fabric/blob/main/docs/REMAINING_WORK.md). This is a **release candidate**, not a claim of complete canon, all platform/remote acceptance, full localization, final balance or third-party rights clearance. Modrinth eligibility is separately constrained by its current AI-content policy; no submission has been made.

releases.notes:
# The Metallic Arts 0.8.0-alpha.2

Minecraft Java **26.1**, Java **25**, Fabric Loader **0.18.4+**, Fabric API **0.145.1+26.1**. Install the ordinary jar on server and clients; the sources jar is for development. Back up the entire world and remove the old mod jar.

- Canonical-once compounding, exact typed-power accounting and nonduplicating Copper restoration.
- Prepared Koloss/Inquisitor/Kandra player bodies, dependencies, wolf/slime rendering, finite compulsion and default-off exceptional extraction.
- Validated advanced balance/progression policy, protection hooks, owned-reference diagnostics, injury/bandage/Gold recovery, paid pulse history, fractional temporal clocks, memory search/annotation and merchant familiarity.
- Once-only survival discovery, finite-fuel powered hostile mobs, mixed ordinary vials and 2–3 unsealed-core carriers.
- Separate Lerasium/alloy items, explicit crouch-use and optional default-off survival acquisition. Other god metals are deferred.
- In-game Guide, initial localization, upgrade/recovery/compatibility documentation and immutable release automation.

The public, host-configurable RashekKholin/The17thShard UUID access remains; it grants no operator privileges or free fuel.

Read the [README](https://github.com/RashekKholin/metallic-arts-fabric#readme), [actual validation](https://github.com/RashekKholin/metallic-arts-fabric/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_VALIDATION.md) and [remaining work](https://github.com/RashekKholin/metallic-arts-fabric/blob/main/docs/REMAINING_WORK.md). This alpha implements bounded interpretations; it does not claim every canonical interaction, complete localization, arbitrary NPC powers, third-party/platform certification or licensing clearance.


Alpha.2 corrects stale provenance and historical documentation from alpha.1; tested mechanics are unchanged.
